# Morocco Desert Trips

> Luxury desert tours and trekking experiences across Morocco's Sahara, Atlas Mountains, and iconic destinations like Merzouga and Marrakech.

Morocco Desert Trips specializes in curated multi-day and day-trip experiences featuring camel trekking, Berber culture, glamping, and desert expeditions. The company offers private and guided tours ranging from 2-5 days, with routes connecting major cities like Marrakech, Fes, and desert destinations including Erg Chebbi and Erg Chigaga.

## Key Topics

- Marrakech
- Sahara Desert
- Merzouga
- Camel Trekking
- Berber Culture
- Erg Chebbi Dunes
- Atlas Mountains
- Private Tours
- Desert Expeditions
- Fes
- Agafay Desert
- Glamping
- Guided Tours
- Ouarzazate
- Ait Ben Haddou

## Multi-Day Desert Expeditions

- [Exclusive Private Morocco Desert Tours](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/private-morocco-desert-tours): Main product page for private luxury Sahara desert tours with camel trekking
- [2 Days Marrakech to Zagora Desert Tour](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/2-days-to-zagora-from-marrakesh): Specific tour package: 2-day Marrakech to Zagora with Atlas Mountains
- [3 Days Desert tour from Marrakesh to Merzouga](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakesh-to-merzouga): 3-day luxury desert tour from Marrakesh to Merzouga Erg Chebbi dunes
- [4 Days Desert Tour From Marrakech Merzouga Erg Chebbi](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/4-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech): 4-day Marrakech to Merzouga Erg Chebbi Sahara expedition with Kasbahs
- [5 Days from Marrakesh to Merzouga Desert and Erg Chebbi dunes](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/5-days-from-marrakesh): 5-day Marrakesh to Merzouga with camel trekking and Berber camp experiences
- [4 Days Desert Tour Marrakech to Erg Chigaga and Desert](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/marrakech-to-erg-chigaga): 4-day off-road 4x4 expedition from Marrakech to Erg Chigaga dunes

## Marrakech to Fes Desert Routes

- [3 Days tour from Marrakech to Fes via Merzouga Desert](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/marrakech-to-fes-via-merzouga): 3-day Marrakech to Fes via Merzouga Sahara with camel rides
- [4 Days from Marrakesh to Fes via Sahara Desert Tour](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/4-days-from-marrakesh-to-fes-via-sahara-desert): 4-day Marrakesh to Fes via Sahara desert with High Atlas and Merzouga
- [3 Day Desert Tour From Fes to Marrakech Via Morocco Desert](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/3-day-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-fes): 3-day Fes to Marrakech via Atlas Mountains and Todra Gorges
- [4 Days Fes to Marrakech Desert Tour](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/fes-to-marrakech-desert-tour-4-days): 4-day Fes to Marrakech Sahara tour with Berber culture and Erg Chebbi

## Agafay Desert Experiences

- [Agafay Desert Tours](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/agafay-desert-tours): Main Agafay Desert tours page with sunset camel treks and glamping
- [Agafay Sunset Tour: Jeep of Road With Camel Ride and Tea](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/agafay-sunset-tour): Agafay sunset tour with jeep, camel ride, and Berber nomad tent tea
- [Agafay Desert Trip Quad Bike /camel Ride /tea Break /dinner](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/agafay-desert-trip): Agafay day trip with quad biking, camel rides, and desert dining
- [2 Days to Agafay Desert Tour & High Atlas mountains](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/agafay-desert-tour): 2-day Agafay and High Atlas tour with luxury camp and activities

## Day Trips from Marrakech

- [Day Trips From Marrakech](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/day-trips-from-marrakech): Day trip options from Marrakech: Agafay, Atlas Mountains, Essaouira
- [guided Tour of Marrakech](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/guided-tour-of-marrakech): Guided walking tour of Marrakech medina, Bahia Palace, Majorelle Garden
- [Half Day Tour of Marrakech to All Attractions and Historical Sites](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/half-day-tour-of-marrakech): Half-day Marrakech tour: Majorelle Garden, Bahia Palace, souks
- [Day Trip From Marrakech to Atlas Mountains](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/day-trip-from-marrakech-to-atlas-mountains): Full day Atlas Mountains excursion with Berber villages and waterfalls
- [Full Day Trip From Marrakech to Ourika](https://moroccodeserttrips.com/booking/ourika-day-trip): Ourika Valley day trip with Berber villages, waterfalls, Setti Fatma
